decision_conditions: The works hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this consent.Reason: This is required by Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Building and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended).

Prior to the commencement of development, the following details shall be provided to the local planning authority for approval(a) Method Statement for the removal of existing paintwork (b) Manufacturers specification of any materials to be used(c) Manufacturers specification for the proposed render to be used to carry out repair and repointing works(d) A test panel on brickwork of the proposed paint to be usedReason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The fixing points of the proposed artwork, wayfinding and any other signage shall as far as possible be limited to the mortar and the brickwork shall only be used where deemed necessary.Reason: To safeguard the special architectural and historic interest in accordance with police DM12 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012 and HC1 of the London Plan 2021

Any works of making good shall match the existing building in respect of materials, colour, texture and profile.Reason: To safeguard the special architectural and historic interest  in accordance with police DM12 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012 and HC1 of the London Plan 2021
